I added automated YARA-based content scanning to the package upload flow.

### New files

**`warehouse/utils/scanner.py`** — the scanning module:

- `_get_rule_message(rule)` — pulls the `message` value out of a matched rule's metadata.
- `check_members(members, rules=None, *, archive_name="")` — iterates `(path, size, data)` tuples, skips members over `_SCAN_MAX_FILE_SIZE`, falls back to module-level `_rules`, returns `None` when no rules are available or on `yara_x.ScanError`. It bulk-scans buffered members for speed, confirms any bulk hit against individual files (discarding cross-boundary false positives), and switches to per-file scanning once accumulated bytes exceed `_BULK_SCAN_MAX_TOTAL` — all while preserving first-match ordering.
